normative_facts: CPU and peripheral accesses remain32-bit; DR payload16-bit, SRAM elements8-bit and WIDTH7 frames are distinct. SIZE controls FLASH/RAM width.
Native CR2 gates are DMARX1/DMATX2; SPI1/2/3 RX/TX selectors are6/7,8/9,10/11. TYPE1/BLOCK/SIZE0/REPEAT1 and CCNT remaining state retain the native terminal contract.

DR reads clear RXNE; writes clear TXE. BUSY0 drains buffer and shifter. MODF/OV remain sticky, all four error sources are retained, and there is no BUSY interrupt. ICR FLUSH is destructive and no-op seed255 is preserved.
Four channels use DMACH12 IRQ9 and DMACH34 IRQ10. IRQ11 is CORDIC. SPI1 uses IRQ25 and SPI2/3 share SPI23 IRQ26.
Exact package routes, twelve selected physical pads, nine AF cells,64KiB Flash/8KiB SRAM and generic empty memory/packages agree with own source and generated metadata.
Native SPI and DMA register geometry/access match existing authored/generated/PAC products. The native five-view CCNT correction and classic23-view STATUS discrepancy remain separate.
